summary: Olivia Strand and Victor Zheng of Frostbyte AI contacted Aegis Cloud Security support because the newly released Identity attribute mapping UI rejected their SCIM workerType field, blocking contractor-specific role assignment for about 60 contractors who still had full employee access, an issue already flagged by their SOC 2 auditor. Elena Vasquez found the UI was auto-matching workerType to the built-in boolean contractor flag, and walked them through mapping it to a custom attribute with an assignment rule, which worked on a test account. Victor stressed that this remains a workaround because Aegis Identity lacks hierarchical role inheritance, forcing duplicate role maintenance that caused the audit finding. Elena filed a bug on the validation behavior, added Frostbyte's audit impact to the role inheritance feature request, and recommended a two-batch rollout.
